            boolean _initialItemsCreated
            True after Panel3D.createInitialItems() has been invoked for this panel.

            Initial items are created when the first OpenGL context is initialized, rather than from the constructor. This avoids invoking an overridable method while a subclass is only partially constructed.

            com.jogamp.opengl.awt.GLJPanel gljpanel
            The hosted OpenGL panel, or null if OpenGL could not be initialized on this system (see Panel3D.isGLAvailable()). Every method in this class that touches gljpanel already null-checks it, so a null value here degrades gracefully to a no-op rather than an NPE.
